#C236196003Sakura#CDEF is right.

Apocalypse Now!

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF is right.

Obtained
#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.
Obtained
Try again?
So you did make it in time.
Hm? What with the spiel, you wannabe?
#C236196003Archer#CDEF silently draws his swords.

…hmph. I know that stupid Servant
is acting cocky.

But what about you, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF?
Am I evil, after all?
Are our values irreconcilable?
"…they are," I nod.

Fine. Then die a pig's death.
You're a useless slave whose only worth
is to pour blood over me!

Why…? Why do I have to lose!?
This is impossible. I won't take this…!
After three losses, her mind still hasn't caved.

Now, Darling. Give the requiem for her soul.
She announced the full severing of her ties.
Confront her with your views.
―――I understand.

Fine. Try and strip me down if you can.
However―――
―――This is the end for us.

Ahh…
My body is going to serve as her bath――

Your blood will definitely make me extra pretty.
I mean… won't it?
Extol my beauty.
#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF whispers in a stupor.

The sight of her slumped on the ground makes her look weary.
#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's instincts are… deep down, a
much younger, innocent girl's.
That's why I came here to face her.

She talks about lashes, but there are no whips here.
Only #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's own body.

Hya!?
Sto―wh-what?

Stop this!!
D-don't touch my tail…
I-it tickles…!!

This has to be the last "whip" she's got.
I'll take hold of this dragon tail she's so proud of.

Hyow! Wh―hey―stupid,
aha, haha, I can't!

It tickles, I told you!
I-I'm sensitive, around my reverse scale!
…alright, let's check.

Ahh…!
Sto―no,
what are you trying to do…!?

Y-you can't!
This is so embarrassing,
you're skipping bases here…!
Ho-ho-ho?
―as if we're holding hands…!
―――Oh no.

Plus… you're being so gentle…
N-no, we can't. We're in completely
different social classes…

…
#C236196003Eliza#CDEF is starting to burst into tears.

It's as if her dragon brain is a whipped syrup
of sugar dissolved into honey.

Also, I've realized a certain truth:
red twin-tails means she's one of THOSE.

I see.
#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF isn't necessarily masochistic.
Romance!?
& Sweets!?
Now this is a surprise.

I-i-i-if you really wanted me to,
I wouldn't mind describing someone like
you during my interviews.

Hee hee, of course.
No surprise.

And if you really wanted,
I could cook for you every da-yeeEHHH!?
She looks she's been tossed out like a raggedy cloth.
The numerous thorns nested in her mind, her:
Beauty Bias
Damn, so I was wrong…
It's #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's "crime" and nothing more.
What troubles #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF is―――
Her cries border on obsession.
That's why her third #C000246204SG#CDEF is―――
Purity
Idol

To simply be loved and never grow up,
to become a young and beautiful idol.
P-PERVERT!!
T-this is some vicious slander…!
I can't let her say what she pleases.
If I'm a groper-#[piggy][squirrelly]#, then #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF is a―――
Ahhn!

S-stop it, don't come near me―――
I'll do whatever you say,
please, don't hurt me…!

N-no, it's tearing…!
Why are my clothes coming apart!?

I mean, look, um,
doing that… means…
Means…

I-I-I will NEEEVVVEERR do something
like that, hear me!?
I hear her whispering.

And like, i-if we… you know, did it,
we would have to get married, right…?
Really!?
She finally bursts into tears.

Why!?
Why!?!?

I'm an eternal, true noble!
I mean, how could I live my life otherwise!?
Never changing.

That's her final pillar.
However―――
N-no… noooooo!!

Look… Look, real close.
Look at me.
Please look at me, come on, come ON!

Love―
Love is eternal, isn't it?

Don't be dumb!
What's the point of being considered
beautiful out of pity…!?

That won't do…
There's no way I can handle that…

…she probably couldn't trust herself.
That's why she's become so insistent now.
But――

That's why I, as a true noble, must reign with
beauty and youth. Yes, I will NEVER become
an ADULT!

Ah, ahh… no, that's… I can't.
It's wonderful, yet, I can't… I can't…
…I see.

To accept becoming an adult, she needed
someone to love her despite no longer being perfect.
…this will be my last reply.
The inescapable truth I tell her is―――

#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF, who was previously sobbing,
unbelievably murmurs with composure:

All humans are able to do is judge others.
I never once sought to be saved.
I hear a raspy sound close to my ears.
…her helpless silence weighs heavily.

She can't be saved.
She's long past redemption.

―――, ah, ah―――
I-I, know―――

―――I know, that…
I-I'm well aware!

…*hic, sniff*…
Waaahhhh!
Dummy! Dummy-dummy-DUMMY!
#C236196003Eliza#CDEF starts crying like a child.
…but someone had to tell her.

For her sake, no one charged her with her crimes;
someone had to tell her that her time has come.

Sniff… hic…!
I know… I know, that I'm just a
homicidal maniac!

I'm sorry, I'm sorry―――
I'm sorry for wanting to always be beautiful…
I'm sorry for wanting to be in love…

You knew about me,
you touched my reverse scale…

But you still can't save me…
No one can save me…

All I ever, ever wanted…
was to be loved forever…!
#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF#C080080080's mind is collapsing.#CDEF

―――Enough. No more.
There's no way I'm going to let you…
pollute me any further.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, you appear to have accumulated

I'm concerned about #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

We went from the Relief rooted in her brain
to the firmly shut inside of her mind.
And in there, lying in wait, was a crimson red idol.

…but what's going on?
#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's expression is unusually grave.
She's settled down with the reckless abandon she had before.

I can judge situations pretty well.
I realized that you two would reach me before
I took over this body.

#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's expression is oddly composed.
She looks as if nothing impresses her,
as if she no longer holds onto any hope in reality.

…wait a second.
Maybe this is the listless girl she used to be,
before she knew what an "idol" was.

Hey. Since this is our last chance,
I have to ask. Why are you getting in my way?

Thinking about it carefully, there really
isn't any reason for us to fight, is there?
It's a little late for that.

This is the inside of my friend's body.
It's a place that mustn't be violated.

And that's not all.
If we let #C236196003BB#CDEF continue, humanity's desires will be unleashed,
spelling the demise of our species.

If that happens, there won't be a
#C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF―or anything else left.
There's a crisis there which must be prevented.

…I'm shocked.
I thought it was just talk, but you really
are fighting for such a reason.

Listen. I don't care about the #C000246204Holy Grail#CDEF
or humanity. The future of the Earth
doesn't matter to me.

I don't mind if civilization crumbles.
Only one thing matters:

That I, and only I, am forever the most
beautiful woman there is―――
THIS is the inviolable law, the truth.

Get it? So long as I'M beautiful, it doesn't
matter if humanity dies out. You say you'll
save humanity, but there's no need.

Yes! Rather, save ME!
That will equate to saving humanity.
My beauty is worth the weight of the Earth!

Chills run down my spine.
She's fanatical about being the most important
and only one in the worl――
No, about how she alone must never lose her beauty.

She's more of a child crying out for help
than she is an Ego―――

Fool, I'M the one who's shocked! The thunderous
applause is what reflects who you are―
Show me a stage with no audience!

You don't care about what happens to the world?
Everything in the world moves for your benefit?

Do you understand? You just defiled the
image of how idols should be, the image
you embraced!

Wha… What are you on about?
Audience are just pigs who make a racket!
They're totally replaceable!

Nice howling, there.
I'm sure once an "ally of justice" finds you,
you'll be jumping with joy.

…*sigh*.
Cursing humans for her own benefit,
treading on the gains of others…

Well, that's what I do for a living,
so I won't knock her for it.

For the sake of your desires, you would prey
on the entire world―――
That's good. Such are human beings.

They're not. This is why you're alone.
I don't know why you brooded so much to
reach that conclusion. However―――

As your friend, I'm going to give you some
tough love. If there is no one left to
teach you, then I must do so.

That's fine. It has nothing to do with me
as I am now, either. We'll never come to
an understanding.

Unfortunately, I have neither the duty nor
the luxury to pay your fanaticism any mind.

You don't do it in a very business-like way,
though. You're just a selfish girl.
A persecution complex, in the flesh.

But that's permitted only if the claim is true,
and if the desire you crave for comes from the
soul. A false desire is no shout, but a cry.

Ready your lance, dragon girl.
My blade shall cut that fanaticism of
yours down.

Even if your sense of right and wrong is broken,
if you're human, your sins must be atoned for.
You're too human to be talking of dragons.

―――He's angry.
Though quiet, this anger is emanating from his entire body.

Dragon girl.
Is this "beauty" you wish for really a
truth which was born out of yourself?

Deep down, #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF hasn't changed at all.
She's a murderer who treats others as consumables
for her own gain.

―――No matter how many humane aspects of
herself she shows me, I can't approve
of her personality.

Yes. In the end, it seems that so long
as I am who I am, you and I can't see
eye to eye.
She takes a short breath and smiles with self-scorn.

I thought you had promise, but ultimately,
you're just another pig.

I'll let you cry as much as you want.
This is my final, serious, genuine stage!

#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF, defeated, is finally depleted of her strength.
Yet, her eyes are still lit with dignified
determination and bloodlust.

Praetor. With your words―no one else's―
sweep this girl's dreams away.

…yeah. You should tell her. Tell her what went
wrong, and why she couldn't understand
us up until the very end.

She never knows when to quit. Still, she was
brave enough not to deceive herself…
I'll give her that, at least.

You don't know why you lost?
#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, it's your turn.
This girl was… a little too much of a maiden.

She's bound by the chain known as "vice."
If she refuses to budge in the slightest,
do not hesitate to end her life.
This time, I'll settle things with #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF once and for all.

Heh. The usual punishment time, is it? …your
face says this is just retribution towards the
rulers. You're just like the other commoners.

You'll be giving me fair compensation.
You're diving into the dragon's den.
Don't cry when I swallow you whole…!
On the verge of death, #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF snarls at me.

…I can't run after coming all this way.
I'll face her final counterattack head-on.

She's a demon who preyed on countless people
for the sake of her beauty.
I have to completely crush her mind…!

#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's overwhelming power ran #C236196003#SVT#CDEF through.
#C236196003#SVT#CDEF's body crumbles and disappears without
even a whimper.

Too bad…
Yes, it really is too bad, #[piggy][squirrely]#.

#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF thrusts her sharp lance.
But my limbs have lost their strength and can't move.

You'll become a part of my beauty…
For ever, and ever, and ever―――

She then raises her lance―――
And #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF's memory ends there.

…oh.
So the me outside lost, huh?
I kind of had a feeling that would happen.

So… what are you planning to do with me?
You came all the way here.
Are you not afraid of me?

I'm not afraid.
Rather, #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF is the one who's afraid.

Now I just need to pierce inside her and
burst open her heart.

………
Stop staring at me. You're just a #[piggy][squirrely]#.
It's disrespectful. Filthy.

If you want to praise me for my beauty,
then let's give you 100 lashes first.
Then maybe I'll consider letting you.

…wait.
I get it. That's what she means.
Then gladly―――

She's lost a lot of strength so I should be fine,
but I really wouldn't like for it to whip around and smack me.
I'll grab it nice and tight.
A reverse scale! She's got one of those?

Among all the scales covering a dragon's body,
there's just one scale that's inverted.

They say if you touch it, the dragon will enrage
and slaughter you…

You hear that about Eastern dragons,
but #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF is a Western dragon.
Does she have one?

As long as I don't touch it, I should be okay.
The part I'm touching should be fine,
so I'll try moving her tail around.
I'm sure I'll be able to find that reverse scale―――

You're touching #RUBS a dragon's #RUBEmy#REND ruby-red scales,
with eyes that are bloodshot, like a beast…
It's… almost as if, we're ho-ho-ho―

I couldn't take hearing that,
and almost ended up falling forward.

You may be a piggy that gets how beautiful I am,
but you're still a pig… It's sad, but this is
something that simply won't do!

You may be my type of squirrely, but you're
still a commoner. …if I start making exceptions
for my blood baths, lines will start blurring.

It irritates me to hear her call me "#[piggy][squirrely]#" again,
but at this point, I figured she would.

That's precisely what #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's first #C000246204SG#CDEF is.
It's called―――
Lovestruck & Loves To Cook
Masochist & Tsundere

If lowly cattle grabbing her tail and pushing her down
makes her happy, then this should be the right answer.

…huh?
Did I make a mistake?

The disapproved, forbidden love between two
of different social statuses… *sigh*.
Well, that certainly is romance…

It's simply present in the basis of all her ideas.
A pesky maiden's dreams―――
Which is to say:

She's simply so vulnerable that I ended
up pointing out two of her #C000246204SGs#CDEF in one go.

S-so what!?
What's wrong with being lovestruck!?

Leaks of private info, late night dates at
convenience stores, sudden marriage…!
Scandals are how idols make their exits!

That's some odd logic.
If you end up getting married, then your idol days are over.

Now that you mention it, you're RIGHT!
…ahem. Well, you know. I went a bit
far with the marriage bit.

While the agency is denying it,
I'll give hints during interviews.

My favorite type of gentleman, what I
want out of a lover, what I want to do,
where I want to go…

The fans reading that article might feel bitter,
but they'll have conceited fantasies about if
they were my lover.

The one and only me.
The fantasy lover of tens of thousands.

I wonder if you understand, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.
THIS is the true thrill one gets out of
being an idol. Along with, um…

#C236196003Eliza#CDEF implores me with her glances.
She alternates looking at my hand holding her tail and my face.
Blushing, she then speaks:

If you really wanted me to, I could say during
my interviews that "rather than a lover,
I found myself a wonderful pet."
I respectfully decline the offer.

H-huh?
Just now, you said "respectfully,"
but did you get the part after that, right!?
I respectfully decline the offer.

I wouldn't be happy about having my name and picture
plugged in magazines, plus honestly, being with
an idol sounds like a major hassle.

Grr… D-don't go throwing me away…
Even if I turn into a raggedy cloth,
treat me with care…

You chased me so zealously, and you're even
gripping my tail right now―yet you say
you haven't a smidgen of love for me…

So long as I have love that never fades,
my boredom should fade away…

Ahh, so bored, so bored…
My head feels like it's splitting…

#C236196003Eliza#CDEF holds her own shoulders
and furrows her eyebrows, crestfallen.

Whether in wanting love, in giving love, in the unusual things―
without change, there's only ennui.
However, she never had any desire to change.

Nobles are nobles.
Cattle are cattle.
She's young and pretty, and will always be young and pretty.

The permanence of it all might be the cause of
all her troubles.

…I'm not here to accuse her for having these #C000246204SGs#CDEF.
But I need to point them out in order to expose
#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's mind.
Chronic Headaches

My bias towards beauty is what's troubling
me…? …what a let down.
Honestly, that one put me off.

It's not typical to seek a bizarre method like blood baths
to preserve one's beauty, but still, beauty
isn't what's troubling #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF.

Those blood baths were nothing more to her than
a part of her "personal grooming."

…yeah.
These headaches are my one and only flaw.

But it's not so farfetched, is it?
Beautiful, noble girls like myself are delicate.
It's a given.

If scandals are the essence of being an idol,
then boredom is the essence of being a noble.
Don't confuse me for a lowly amoeba like you.
So this is what it means to be an aristocrat, huh?

That's why she had no concern or remorse
torturing and slaughtering girls in her territory.
None, even if the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF's participants
were sacrificed for her blood baths.

So long as they were never human like her to begin with,
she would never realize her crimes or come to question it.

A twisted sense of values brought on by a maiden's personality.
That's the basis for #C236196003Elizabeth Báthory#CDEF.

…hmph.
Isn't it natural for nobles to have
social privileges?

Beauty, wealth, lineage; these are all things
of value. Things that must endure. Nothing
sacrificed for that pursuit will be missed.

I have to protect those things.
I mustn't let them be tarnished.

My beauty, my lineage, my castle, my fame!
I live not like the nightly-changing moon,
but eternally like the shining sun!

She's so afraid of no longer being a noble
and no longer being a young, beautiful girl
that she's unable to take steps towards acquiring new things.
That's why she wanted to become an idol… I guess?

…no, this doesn't seem right.
#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF isn't hiding the fact that she's an idol, anyway.
The thing she's embarrassed about is―――

There's a pervert over here―actually,
there's a pervert grabbing my tail…
W-which means…

A groper!
There's a groper over here!!
Help, I'm going to get locked up!!

First cattle, now a groper?
#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF's status as the
protagonist has hit rock bottom.

I let go of her tail as I call her out.
It limply slithers across the floor.

I pointed out all of her #C000246204SGs#CDEF, and I suppose her
